notes.title: New Information!🤩
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

There are new Informations about the Game.




1. There will be a class system.

2. At the beginning there will only be 1 playable card and and about 3 classes. You can find out which ones they are for publication.

3. There will also be a global leaderboard that will allow you to fight your way to the top.

4. The combat system is realistically adjusted so that you have to save ammo. Furthermore, major injuries will not be treatable. Small ones, however, with bandages.

5. Vehicles will not be available at the beginning. However, they will be added with a later update.
